messages:
nina: FYI - onboarded orion-lite-int4 hit mem fragmentation OOMs on canary under high-gen tests. Happens when batch>=5 and max_new_tokens >= 512.

suresh: Reproed with harness. q4_k_packed shows many small frees; freelist saturation ~0.9 before OOM.

alex: Logs show alloc failures then eviction thrashing:
```
[2026-04-10T11:02:05Z] WARN allocator: freelist_saturation=0.91
[2026-04-10T11:02:05Z] ERROR alloc: cannot satisfy 1.0G request
```

maria: Quick mitigations: lower default max_new_tokens for int4 -> 300, disable aggressive prefetch, and enable opt-in microbatching.

suresh: Prototype microbatching (chunks of 256) prevents OOM in stress runs but increases latency ~20%. Need streaming merge validation.

infra-bot: Canary defaults updated (PR #4890). Monitoring 30m.

nina: After change, 1h smoke: no OOMs, p95 +15ms.

alex: Action items: nina update onboarding docs, suresh finish microbatch streaming tests, alex add freelist_saturation metric and auto-fallback to int8 when >0.85 for 5m.
